svg.title: ScopeCompose: the differential
svg.desc: Plate four, ScopeCompose: a planetary differential. The carrier, the query, drives three planets; the sun and the ring both turn, one carrying the general rule (a 3% fee on international transactions), the other the exception (waived for premium-tier cardholders). A selector keeps one branch; a differential keeps both. Conflict-aware RAG deletes valid exceptions; ScopeCompose detects the conflict, recovers its scope and composes both, with Suppression Rate to measure the deletion. Final-year research, two members: pipeline built with 501 tests, no results yet.
